title: Unstructured Buyer Volume vs. Structured Market Position

columns.label: Unstructured Buyer Pool (Audience)
columns.description: Naive aggregation without governance or exit rights

columns.label: Structured Market Position (DC2SC)
columns.description: Ratified coordination with enforceable constraint floors

cells.person: Representation: Explicit ratified mandate from participants

cells.market: Surplus Capture: Extracted as platform commission or seller margin
cells.person: Surplus Capture: Retained as participant constraint satisfaction

cells.market: Information Parity: Supplier sees volume; buyers remain blind
cells.person: Information Parity: Intelligible shared constraint visibility

cells.market: Failure Mode: Lock-in to suboptimal bulk contract
cells.person: Failure Mode: Orderly fallback to independent outside option

caption: Comparison of structural dynamics between passive buyer volume and participant-governed market positions.
scopeLimits: Conceptual framework comparison. Does not assert empirical commission percentages or price differentials.
limitations: Theoretical distinction; live empirical performance depends on supplier market concentration.

accessibility.textEquivalent: Matrix contrasting unstructured buyer pools with structured market positions across representation, exit, surplus, information, and failure modes.
